newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid stocks rebound to strong gains.
newsitem.headline: Madrid stocks rebound to strong gains.

text.p: The Madrid bourse ended sharply higher on Tuesday, with all sectors gaining amid a recovery abroad from sharp losses on Friday and Monday.
But dealers said the market could remain volatile.
"The drop in the last two days was very exaggerated and therefore we had a recovery today, but the short-term tendency will continue to be very volatile," a dealer said.
* The general index closed up 5.29 points, or 1.14 percent to 467.72. The Ibex-35 registerd a gain of 62.73, or 1.19 percent, to 5,336.68.
*Argentaria was a leader among financials rising 4.31 pct.
